issuing_body: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室), Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (工业和信息化部), Ministry of Public Security (公安部), and National Radio and Television Administration (国家广播电视总局)
covered_actors: AI-generated synthetic content service providers (提供生成合成服务的服务提供者)
Network information content dissemination service providers (提供网络信息内容传播服务的服务提供者)
Users publishing AI-generated synthetic content via network information content dissemination services (用户)
Any organizations and individuals (任何组织和个人)
prohibited_practices: Maliciously deleting, tampering with, forging, or concealing AI-generated synthetic content labels required under the Measures
Providing tools or services to others to maliciously delete, tamper with, forge, or conceal required AI-generated synthetic content labels
Harming the legitimate rights and interests of others through improper labeling methods

evidence.quote: 服务提供者提供生成合成内容下载、复制、导出等功能时，应当确保文件中含有满足要求的显式标识。
evidence.quote_en: When service providers offer functions such as downloading, copying, or exporting generated or synthesized content, they shall ensure that the files contain explicit labels that meet the requirements.

evidence.quote: 有前款第一项至第三项情形的，应当在文件元数据中添加生成合成内容属性信息、传播平台名称或者编码、内容编号等传播要素信息。
evidence.quote_en: Under any of the circumstances in items (1) to (3) of the preceding paragraph, dissemination element information such as attribute information of the generated or synthesized content, the name or code of the dissemination platform, and the content identifier shall be added to the file metadata.

enforcement_authorities: Cyberspace Administration of China (国家互联网信息办公室)
Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (工业和信息化部)
National Radio and Television Administration (国家广播电视总局)
Provincial, autonomous region, municipal, and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps cyberspace, communications/industry, public security, and radio/television authorities
implementation_notes: Jointly promulgated departmental regulation (国信办通字〔2025〕2号) grounded in the Cybersecurity Law and existing algorithm, deep synthesis, and generative AI rules. The provided text (Notice and Articles 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10) mandates explicit user-perceptible labels and implicit file-metadata labels for synthetic content providers, metadata verification and labeling by dissemination platforms, and user self-declaration, while encouraging digital watermarks. Effective date and penalty provisions do not appear in the provided text.
